We present a 1/12 global ocean simulation to quantify early warning signals of Atlantic Meridional Overturning
Circulation (AMOC) collapse. Across 800-year freshwater hosing ramps (0–0. 6 Sv), we track variance, lag-1
autocorrelation _1, and detrended fluctuation exponent α of the AMOC strength and SST dipole . The high-resolution
model, which explicitly resolves mesoscale eddies, yields Fcrit = 0. 32 ± 0. 03 Sv, 0. 10 Sv higher than 1…
